title: Three 9-foot skeletons vanish overnight

tellings.quote: So he laid them out, three bodies. They were at least 9 ft tall each. Next day, they were gone.

plain: Sometime between 1978 and 1981, a man at the Church of Santa Anastasia on the Italian island of Sardinia laid out three skeletons that were each at least 9 feet tall, and the next day they were gone, according to Tim Alberino, a filmmaker who chases stories of giants. Alberino passes on what he was told: "So he laid them out, three bodies. They were at least 9 ft tall each. Next day, they were gone." If true, it would mean real evidence of giant humans was found and then quietly taken away.
